transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'd like to get our review scheduled for the v1 reporting API retirement plan. As a reminder, the v1 API is currently targeted for retirement on September 30, and the replacement v2 API is available and has passed the documented compatibility tests. Before I finalize the plan, I need to review it with both the API platform team and customer success as part of our normal release-readiness process. Could we get a time on the calendar to walk through the retirement plan together?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we schedule that review. While reviewing mobile telemetry today, I confirmed that the current mobile SDK still calls v1 for 38% of reporting requests, and SDK 6.4 will not reach the required adoption level until November 10. This means v1 must remain dual-served through November 14, and we'll need a migration clinic for affected application teams. I haven't filed the platform note yet, but I wanted to surface this now so the retirement date can be adjusted before we finalize anything.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to add an important contractual constraint to the record. This morning I confirmed with the account team that the Northstar contract requires 60 days of notice before the v1 reporting API is retired and guarantees access through November 14. I found this clause while preparing a renewal brief and haven't yet added it to the release record. This aligns with Mina's telemetry finding — we cannot retire v1 on September 30 without breaching the Northstar contract.
